pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHEN IT'S YOUR TIME TO GO, MAKE SURE YOU'RE SURROUNDED BY OTHERS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YES? HOW MAY I HELP YOU?

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: YUP, THAT SHOULD BE IT FOR THE DOCUMENTS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WELL, IT'S KIND OF MY FIRST TIME EXPERIENCING THIS. IT HASN'T REALLY SUNK IN YET...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: MY GRANDPA WOULD BE MAD IF I MOPED AROUND...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...SO I'LL JUST HAVE TO LAUGH WHILE I BURN HIM UP.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: JUJUTSU HIGH SCHOOL FIRST-YEAR MEGUMI FUSHIGURO

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE CURSED OBJECT YOU HAVE IS EXTREMELY DANGEROUS. HAND IT OVER RIGHT AWAY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DON'T REALLY MIND GIVING IT BACK, BUT MY FELLOW CLUB MEMBERS HAVE TAKEN A LIKING AM TO IT. I'D AT LEAST LIKE AN EXPLA- NATION.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: NATIONALLY, THE AVERAGE NUMBER OF UNEXPLAINED DEATHS AND MISSING PERSONS EXCEEDS 10,000 ANNUALLY.
